import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a violin plot to show the distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=data, hue='transaction_type', split=True, inner='quartile')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Fraud Status (0 = No Fraud, 1 = Fraud)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status and Type', fontsize=15)
plt.xticks([0, 1], ['No Fraud', 'Fraud'], fontsize=10)
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
